description: Lists every webhook registered on the account: id, url, status ('active' delivers, 'disabled' means the endpoint returned a 410 Gone and needs re-registering to reactivate), and created_at. The signing secret is not returned here; it is returned at creation alone. Takes no arguments. Cost: Free per call. Docs: https://docs.twitterapis.com/docs/reference/monitoring/webhook-get
name: twitter_monitor_webhook_list
